title: Ibalizumab-uiyk Injection
overview: Ibalizumab-uiyk is used to treat human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection in people whose HIV could not be successfully treated with other medications, including their current therapy. Ibalizumab-uiyk is in a class of medications called monoclonal antibodies. It works by blocking HIV from infecting cells in the body.

Some of the medication and HIV may be passed to your baby in your breast milk. Talk to your doctor about the risks of breastfeeding your baby if you are receiving ibalizumab-uiyk injection.you should know that while you are receiving medications to treat HIV infection, your immune system may get stronger and begin to fight other infections that were already in your body. This may cause you to develop symptoms of those infections. If you have new or worsening symptoms during your treatment with ibalizumab-uiyk injection, be sure to tell your doctor.
